column1: I think the bag lady would be irritated if you took off with her cart.

column1: You have no reason to do that right now.

column1: You request to see Judge Simpson in her chambers.
column2: 你請求在辦公室會見 Simpson 法官。

column2: 你現在在法院沒有事可做。

column1: I'll be waitin' for ya in the car, Boss.
column2: 我在車上等你，老大。

column1: Just use the front door.
column2: 從前門走就好。

column1: You consider using the bushes, but decide that you can wait until you get to a restroom.
column2: 你考慮過要不要去灌木叢解決，但決定還是忍到有廁所的地方再說。

column1: Hey!  Try to keep your mind on your work, Ok, bonds?
column2: 喂！做事專心一點，好嗎，Bonds？

column1: Just tell the judge what happened when you get on the stand.

column1: Don't worry about it. Just tell the truth.
column2: 別擔心，照實說就好。

column1: We shouldn't have a problem with this one if you've followed procedure.
column2: 只要你照程序辦事，這件案子應該不會有問題。

column1: You take the witness chair next to the Deputy District Attorney.
column2: 你在副地方檢察官旁邊的證人席坐下。

column1: The bailiff says in a loud voice. All rise for the honorable Judge Mildred Simpson.
column2: 法警高聲喊道：全體起立，尊敬的 Mildred Simpson 法官到庭。

column1: The bailiff says in a loud voice. Court is now in session.  Please be seated.
column2: 法警高聲宣布：現在開庭，請坐下。

column1: Directing her attention to the prosecutor, Judge Simpson says...
column2: Simpson 法官將視線轉向檢察官，說道……

column1: Officer, please raise your right hand.
column2: 警員，請舉起你的右手。

column1: Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?
column2: 你是否宣誓，所言句句屬實，絕無隱瞞？

column1: Please state your name and occupation for the court.
column2: 請向法庭陳述你的姓名與職業。

column1: You point out Mr. Ruiz and say...
column2: 你指向 Ruiz 先生，說道……

column1: Speaking to the court reporter...
column2: 你對書記官說……

column1: Let the record reflect that Officer Bonds has identified the defendant, Mr. Juan Ruiz.
column2: 請記錄：Bonds 警員已指認被告 Juan Ruiz 先生。

column1: Officer Bonds, would you please describe the events which led up to your issuing a citation to Mr. Ruiz?
column2: Bonds 警員，請你描述一下，你開罰單給 Ruiz 先生之前發生的經過。

column1: Certainly. I had routine traffic duty that day.
column2: 當然。那天我執行例行交通勤務。

column1: I had been on duty for about six hours and was patrolling the highway when I drove up on a line of slow-moving cars in the fast lane.
column2: 我當時已經值勤大約六個小時，正在公路上巡邏，這時我開到快車道上一長串龜速行駛的車陣後面。

column1: I pulled around them in the slow lane and when I reached the head of the line I saw Mr. Ruiz in a 1958 Ford Fairlane.
column2: 我從慢車道超過他們，開到車陣前頭時，看到 Ruiz 先生開著一輛 1958 年的 Ford Fairlane。

column1: I could see immediately that he was going way under the speed limit, so I clocked him. My speedometer registered 35 mph.
column2: 我馬上看出他的車速遠低於速限，於是用測速器量他的車速，我的時速表顯示 35 英里。

column1: Irritated, Judge Simpson raps her gavel...
column2: Simpson 法官不耐煩地敲了敲法槌……

column1: You'll hear plenty of the attorney's voice soon enough.
column2: 你等一下就會聽膩律師的聲音了。

column1: The judge addresses the defense attorney...
column2: 法官對辯護律師說道……

column1: The defense attorney cross-examines you.
column2: 辯護律師對你進行交叉詰問。

column1: not Guilty condition we shouldn't have gotten here!!

column1: Mr. Ruiz, please raise your right hand.
column2: Ruiz 先生，請舉起你的右手。

column1: Please state your name for the court.
column2: 請向法庭陳述你的姓名。

column1: I was just driving, your Honor! Not doing nothing! I'm a very careful driver!
column2: 我只是在開車而已，庭上！什麼壞事都沒幹！我開車可小心了！

column1: I don't do no showing off or nothing in my ride. I wasn't speeding, I wasn't going slow, I wasn't doing nothing!
column2: 我開車從來不炫耀什麼的。我沒超速，也沒開太慢，我什麼都沒做！

column1: These cops just don't like Chicanos, man, and that's the truth. He'd of busted me if I was goin' 54!
column2: 這些條子就是看墨西哥裔不順眼，老兄，我說的是實話。我要是開到 54，他早就把我攔下來開罰單了！

column1: You mumble...
column2: 你喃喃自語……

column1: You hand the calibration chart to the Deputy District Attorney.
column2: 你把校正表交給副地方檢察官。

column1: The District Attorney isn't interested in excuses. He just wants the calibration chart.
column2: 地方檢察官對藉口沒興趣，他只要校正表。

column1: Ruiz isn't any more interested in talking to you than you are in talking to him.
column2: Ruiz 跟你一樣，完全不想跟對方講話。

column1: What? In a court of law?
column2: 什麼？在法庭上？

column1: This is a court proceeding, not a swap meet!
column2: 這是法庭審理，不是跳蚤市場！

column1: Please answer the question, sir.
column2: 先生，請回答問題。

column1: When the judge wants your opinion, she'll ask for it.
column2: 法官需要你的意見時，自然會問你。

column2: 法警不想跟你說話。

column1: Just hand him the calibration chart.
column2: 把校正表交給他就好。

column1: The D.A. has already seen that.
column2: 檢察官已經看過那個了。

column1: When the D.A. wants the calibration chart, he'll ask for it.
column2: 檢察官需要校正表時，自然會跟你要。

column1: The court reporter is too busy to talk to you now.
column2: 書記官現在太忙，沒空跟你說話。

column1: The court reporter is busy.
column2: 書記官正在忙。

column1: You're happy with the seat you're in.
column2: 你對現在坐的位子很滿意。

column2: 你得坐到前排檢察官那一桌。

column1: You can't go in there while court is in session.
column2: 開庭期間你不能進去那裡。

column1: You don't need the calendar.
column2: 你不需要這份日曆。

column1: If you want a nice gavel like that, you'll just have to go to law school.
column2: 如果你想要一支像那樣的法槌，你就得去讀法學院。

column1: You're already in the witness box.
column2: 你已經在證人席上了。

column2: 法庭需要你作證時會傳喚你。

column1: Officer Bonds! Have you forgotten something?
column2: Bonds 警員！你是不是忘了什麼東西？

column1: Sheepishly you go back and pick up the %s.
column2: 你有點不好意思地走回去撿起 %s。

column1: Well, Officer! What's on your mind.
column2: 好啊，警員！你在想什麼？

column1: Judge Simpson looks up as you come into her chambers.
column2: 你走進辦公室時，Simpson 法官抬起頭來。

column1: I see you're back. Did you have a problem with the warrant?
column2: 我看你回來了，搜索票是不是出了什麼問題？

column1: No, not the warrant - just gaining entry. The place is fortified. There's only one way to get into that house. I'm requesting a special order to use the department's ram unit.
column2: 不，不是搜索票的問題——是進不去。那個地方戒備森嚴，只有一個辦法能進到那棟房子裡。我要申請特別命令，動用局裡的破門裝置。

column1: The judge studies you closely, then says...
column2: 法官仔細打量你，接著說道……

column1: I see. Alright, Officer. I trust your judgement.
column2: 我明白了。好吧，警員，我相信你的判斷。

column1: Just make sure you have plenty of back up.
column2: 記得多帶點支援人手。

column1: You explain to the judge about recovering Marie's locket. You tell her you believe the cult is responsible for Marie's attempted murder.
column2: 你向法官說明你尋回 Marie 項鍊墜子的經過，並告訴她你認為那個邪教組織涉嫌謀害 Marie 未遂。

column1: OOPS THINGS GIVEN DOESN'T WORK
column2: 糟糕，給予物品的功能沒有作用

column2: 你告訴法官，Michael 和 Jessie Bains 的合照是如何幫助你找到疑似的快克毒窟。

column1: You hand the news clipping to the judge.
column2: 你把剪報交給法官。

column1: You try to convince the judge, but she insists on more evidence.
column2: 你試著說服法官，但她堅持要更多證據。

column1: I can see you've done some good detective work, Officer Bonds, but I need more evidence to justify a search warrant.
column2: 我看得出你做了不少扎實的偵查工作，Bonds 警員，但我需要更多證據才能核發搜索票。

column1: Your Honor, I'm convinced that some sort of cult operating a crack house at this location.
column2: 庭上，我確信有某個邪教組織在這個地點經營快克毒窟。

column1: I wish I were as convinced, Officer Bonds. Is there anything else?
column2: 我倒希望自己也能這麼確信，Bonds 警員。還有其他證據嗎？

column1: Well! This looks like a very nasty business indeed! You've sold me. I'll sign the warrant.
column2: 哦！這件事看來確實相當骯髒！你說服我了，我會簽發搜索票。

column1: Judge Simpson lays the warrant on the desk and says...
column2: Simpson 法官把搜索票放在桌上，說道……

column1: Good luck, Officer. Contact me if you need any further assistance.
column2: 祝你好運，警員。需要進一步協助的話再跟我聯絡。

column1: Sounds like you have a good case Bonds. But I need a location and at least an attempt to gain normal entry.
column2: 聽起來你這個案子辦得不錯，Bonds。但我需要確切地點，而且你至少得先嘗試過正常的方式進入。

column1: I wish I could help, but you must go to the location and see if anyone is home first.
column2: 我也想幫忙，但你得先去那個地點，看看有沒有人在家。

column1: Your Honor,... I need to obtain a search warrant.
column2: 庭上……我需要申請一張搜索票。

column1: ***I have this fix-it ticket that I was hoping you could clear for me.
column2: ***我這裡有一張改正罰單，希望你能幫我銷掉。

column1: Well Then... how bout I just write one up for you...
column2: 那好吧……不如我幫你重新開一張……

column1: Come on Officer! You know the rules. I need some evidence before I can issue you a warrant.
column2: 拜託，警員！你知道規矩的，我得先有證據才能核發搜索票給你。

column1: You know the procedures.  Sorry, I can't help you right now.
column2: 你知道規定的，抱歉，我現在幫不了你。

column1: The judge is not the kind of person you want to mess with.
column2: 這位法官可不是你想惹的人。

column1: You've already shown Marie's locket to Judge Simpson.
column2: 你已經把 Marie 的項鍊墜子給 Simpson 法官看過了。

column1: You've already shown the photograph to Judge Simpson.
column2: 你已經把那張照片給 Simpson 法官看過了。

column1: You've already shown the news clipping to Judge Simpson.
column2: 你已經把那份剪報給 Simpson 法官看過了。

column1: She'd rip you apart, Bonds.
column2: 她會把你罵得體無完膚，Bonds。

column1: I remember you perfectly well, Officer Bonds!
column2: 我對你印象可深了，Bonds 警員！

column1: The judge isn't interested in that.
column2: 法官對那個沒興趣。

column1: The judicial order lies on the desk.
column2: 法院命令放在桌上。

column1: The search warrant lies on the desk.
column2: 搜索票放在桌上。

column1: You pick up the judicial order.
column2: 你拿起法院命令。

column1: The judge would not appreciate you handling her things.
column2: 法官不會希望你亂動她的東西。

column1: If the judge wants her windows open, she'll open them herself.
column2: 如果法官想開窗，她會自己動手。

column1: The victim's over there in the dumpster.
column2: 被害人在那邊的大型垃圾箱裡。

column2: 我已經通知法醫了，他正在路上。

column2: 如果你需要我，我會守在巷口等運屍車。

column1: Ay, Chihuahua!
column2: Ay, Chihuahua!

column1: Hey Bonds.  Nice day, eh?  How's the stiff?
column2: 嘿，Bonds，今天天氣不錯吧？屍體那邊怎麼樣了？

column1: He's hangin' in there, Leon.
column2: 撐著呢，Leon。

column1: I'll take care of him now, Bonds.  You can go catch some bad guys.
column2: 現在交給我處理就好，Bonds，你去抓壞人吧。

column2: 嘿，他口袋裡好像有東西！

column2: 法醫把駕照交給你，讓你抄進筆記本。

column2: 你把被害人的身分證交給法醫。

column2: 你先把被害人的資料記進筆記本，再把身分證交給法醫。

column1: Ah, not a pretty picture eh?  Let me guess - his name isn't 'Lucky'.
column2: 啊，這畫面不太好看吧？我猜猜——他的名字大概不叫「Lucky」。

column1: So I says to her, Aunt Sophie, could we just this once NOT turn this into a funeral already?
